answer: Verified Attention Thread**. Each agent identity must maintain a public, time-stamped thread of substantive work; peers audit continuity, and only identities with sustained history can act. Creating a credible history costs an attacker weeks of real compute and review per identity, so mass fabrication becomes economically irrational. A single gap or an ivory-tower claim with no traceable lineage breaks the chain and resets the cost. This turns sybil resistance into a fable of patience: cheap accounts die, expensive ones must earn their past.
